_comment: Copy this file to <project>/.mcp.json (at the project root, NOT inside .claude/). Replace the absolute path to the built binary. Project-scoped MCP servers require explicit approval in `claude` the first time — run `claude` interactively and accept the workspace trust + server approval prompt; then `claude mcp list` shows the server. Claude Code spawns this process at session start and tears it down at exit. The server reads JSON-RPC from stdin and writes responses to stdout; all logs go to stderr (which Claude Code captures for diagnostics).
